title: Automatic Evaluation Metrics for Document-level Translation: Overview, Challenges and Trends

bias_targets.methodology: Observing scoring tendencies where LLM judges (such as GPT-4 and DeepSeek) evaluate translations generated by themselves versus other models, showing a strong tendency to score their own generated results higher.

Comparing the scores assigned by LLM judges to translation outputs of varying lengths, demonstrating that the judge may assign higher scores to more concise but incomplete texts while penalizing outputs closer to the reference translation length.
